title: Lohagad Fort murder case: Who represents Siya Goyal? Competing claims and a ₹10 crore legal notice
description: Confusion over legal representation has deepened in the Lohagad Fort murder case against 20‑year‑old accused Siya Goyal, with two lawyers now asserting that they are arguing her case.One of the lawyers, Advocate Aashuutosh Srivastava, has issued a legal notice to Sahil Goyal, brother of accused Siya, seeking damages of ₹10 crore over public remarks disputing his appointment as her lawyer.
